title: Newly Single
essence: He leaves the party for an open-air rooftop club over Atlantis, all strobes and blue-pink light, where the dancers smear in shifted time and he stands still and empty. His soul, a glowing see-through copy of him, peels out and floats up, watches the whole city lit below, is set down on a white-hot plain at the equator of a giant planet, and is cooled by angels pouring ice baths; back in the club the same water lands on his body under the strobe. Haze fills the room, the soul comes home, he leans back and breathes it in, and ends on the ledge staring at far mountains, then walks out into a street where he glimpses the EX's back and cannot reach him.
palette_notes: Night #0d1630 and spire blue #3a6fd8 from the Ankhu sheet (cbb5e9c5 aerial, 646ab0f0 misty platforms, 993cc7a2 deck). Purple #9b5fd0 and pink #ff5fa8 are the disc-spires of 959cd1f5 and the treatment's 'blue and pink lights throughout the city'. Soul blue-white #bfe6f2 is the ice blue of the aerial 434b7bdd and the soul glow. Red plain #b0303a and white sun #fbf6ea from 7a904269 (the red ground under a white light). District orange #d36f46 for the one accent: the spark at the soul's head (world module: never on the flesh).

full_text.line: The soul has escaped my body for the moment and left him on the dance floor. He can now just be
flesh and bones, rejection and heartache hit differently when there are no feelings afloat.
I want my soul now to imagine my body pulsing and head throbbing from the music and empty on
a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations. Let's watch strangers collide and spark electric
currents that gamut the mood, a good one. We want him to be the last one to leave, prolonging the
bitter refraction inside the walls of an escape that few pleasures offer us. Now let us put my
soul in the middle of an open field at the equator of a planet much larger than my own
and much hotter. Cool me down by pouring unfiltered water out of the ice bath salted from the closest
moons from angels of the newest religions and its joys capturing my body transiting in a flash of
strobe lights. Their gracious cursor blessed me, only infinity will tell. Now bring my soul back
to my body to lean back, breathe in the smoke that now fills the room and tell myself how good
it is to finally get acquainted with the night, staring into unfamiliar yet relatable mountains
in the distance and wandering eyes and wandering thoughts within reach.

arc.beat: he walks out onto the rooftop club: fast dancing, strobes, time-shifted dancers; he stands still on the moving floor, wincing on each beat; a hand slides off his arm
arc.image: the one still body on a strobing floor of smeared dancers

arc.beat: the translucent soul peels out of the body from the same spot and rises over the dancers' hands; the body sags onto a hip; weights fall at his feet instead of rising
arc.image: two copies of him: solid below, glowing see-through above, looking back down

arc.beat: two strangers collide and spark; cut to the soul far above all of Atlantis lit blue and pink; the floor thins and the body is the last one dancing
arc.image: top-down: the whole city glowing, the soul small in the foreground

arc.beat: the soul stands alone on an endless flat plain whose curve barely shows; the white sun climbs and burns the air off the sky; it shields its eyes; back in the club the body overheats and angels appear in the haze
arc.image: a tiny glowing figure on a red-white plain under a blinding sun, equator ticks across the ground

arc.beat: three angels at different angles tip ice-bath basins over the body under the strobe; on the plain a pool spreads round the soul's feet, salt piling, steam rising
arc.image: three white-winged angels pouring braided streams onto him in the middle of the dance floor

arc.beat: haze rolls in and fills the club; the soul glides down along the path it left by and settles into him; he leans back and breathes the smoke in; small smile
arc.image: the body leaning back in the smoke as the glow sinks under his skin

arc.beat: he sits on the ledge, back to the club, staring at a far mountain range; then (no voiceover) walks the night street, fans reaching for him; he sees the EX's back through the crowd and cannot reach him
arc.image: a seated silhouette on the rooftop ledge against pale mountains beyond the lit city

insights: Never merge the two copies: even after the return keep both cards in frame, the soul printed on acetate over the body. The line never says they became one thing again.
Time shift is a frame-rate contrast: dancers on 2s and 3s with ghost doubles, the poet on 1s. Cheap in cut-out, and it reads instantly.
'Much hotter' is a subtraction: blow the sky away until the plain stands in white; do not add flames.
Intercut body and soul on the pour: the same water lands on both, which is how the poem's 'cool me down' connects two places.
The planet is a floor: a horizon so wide it barely curves; one red-white ground card and ticks, nothing scattered on it (open means empty).
Strobes: keep flashes under safe rates; let the haze and the colour carry the club instead.
The last stanza and the street beat bleed into 09 (Yet Heard): the EX's back through the crowd is the hinge.
future: The soul acetate set returns wherever the poet is beside himself (09, 11).
The rooftop and club crowd (club_dress/shirt/jacket) are reused in 09.
The night street with the EX walking away opens 09; the mountains seen from the rooftop are the horizon he rides toward in 10.
The top-down Atlantis print is reused for 10's dusk exit and 14's ending.
The angels can return in 11 New Day as a blessing image.
